title: Normalize README Markdown headings and command blocks
why: The README commands are functional, but the quick-start and CLI sections have Markdown structure issues: a plain-text heading, a `#CLI` heading without a space, and shell comments mixed with inline code snippets. Cleaning this up would improve rendering without changing behavior.
suggested_scope: Convert the quick-start, CLI, examples, and dev-check snippets to proper Markdown headings and fenced `sh` blocks.
Preserve existing commands exactly unless a command is verified to need correction.
Avoid changing CLI behavior in the same patch.
